name: Phú Quý
headline: Island light, fishing boats, red-rock cliffs.
introduction: Phú Quý is small enough to feel personal and bright enough to make every road look like a detour worth taking.
shortDescription: Turquoise water, fishing boats, volcanic rocks, open roads, and slow island light.
description: Island life at its most untouched --- turquoise water, fishing boats, and red-rock cliffs.
longDescription: The island is less about a checklist and more about timing: ride early, rest when the light gets harsh, and come back outside when the sea turns silver again.
overview: A compact island for bright water, fishing village textures, red rocks, and simple days built around the weather.
weatherNote: Ferry comfort depends on sea conditions. Keep dates flexible if the forecast looks rough.
travelTips: Book ferry timing before locking the full route.
Use mornings for riding and photos.
Bring sun protection; shade can be limited on open roads.
notFor: Travelers who need big-city convenience or luxury options.
seoTitle: Phú Quý Photo Notes | Island Light and Fishing Boats
seoDescription: A short editorial photo note from Phú Quý island: turquoise water, fishing boats, red-rock cliffs, ferry days, and slow coastal light.
